Can I use Boplo without a smart dartboard?

Yes. The first version is built around quick manual scoring, so it works with any standard board. Camera scoring is a future convenience, not a requirement.

Is Boplo a replacement for a darts coach?

No. It is the useful practice layer between coaching sessions: it keeps scores, spots a recurring weakness, and helps you arrive with a better question.

What does Pro actually unlock?

The analysis and progression layer—personalised drills, long-term insights, pressure profile, private groups, and league-readiness view.
